title: SnowGO Pack - Refined
description: The Minecraft Modpack that includes much of the Create Mod and its addons, incredible terrain, and a huge potential for
body:
This modpack focuses on engineering with the Minecraft Create Mod and its various addons like Create Enchantment Industry and Create Crafts and Additions. 
Vast landscapes are generated using Tectonic, making an incredible playground for industry and allowing the full capabilities of the travel mods included (Steam 'n' Rails, Immersive Aircraft, Small Ships). 
All this accompanied by some of the best performance mods (Iris, Sodium, etc) and shaders for a cinematic experience without distracting from the gameplay.
Mods in the modpack may be added or removed at any time in the future, might be some cool mods that aren't in here yet lol.
Not all the mods are activated, some are deactivated for a more "Vanilla Create" experience, but you can activate them at any time.
